description:
[GBER Article 25 R&D&I aid intensity & subsidy ceiling auditor. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits maximum allowable public aid intensities for R&D projects under General Block Exemption Regulation (EU) No 651/2014, computing base rates (Fundamental 100%, Industrial 50%, Experimental 25%), SME top-ups (+10%/+20%), and collaboration bonuses (+15%) up to the statutory 80% cap.
Usage: Use this tool to verify that public research co-funding complies with EU State Aid notification exemptions.
Returns: JSON object with { projectTitle: string, researchCategory: string, baseAidIntensityPercent: number, smeTopUpPercent: number, collaborationBonusPercent: number, finalAllowableAidIntensityPercent: number, statutoryMaxCapEnforced: boolean, financialCalculations: object }.

eligibleCostsEur.description: Total eligible project research expenditure in EUR

enterpriseSize.description: Enterprise size according to EU Recommendation 2003/361/EC

hasCollaborationWithResearchOrganization.description: True if project involves collaboration with a university or research organization bearing at least 10% of costs

hasEffectiveCrossBorderCollaboration.description: True if project involves cross-border collaboration between independent enterprises

hasWideDisseminationOpenAccess.description: True if research results will be widely disseminated through open access or free software

researchCategory.description: Category of research activity ex Art. 25 GBER

name: gber_aid_intensity_checker
